node.statement: Let D=2+4*delta. The row-geometry clause of def-signed-idempotent gives ||p_k-p_j||_1<=D for all rows. With q=S^{-1}sum_k a_k^+p_k, q=sum_k b_k p_k for b_k=a_k^+/S, b_k>=0, sum_k b_k=1, so the triangle inequality gives ||q-p_j||_1<=sum_k b_k||p_k-p_j||_1<=D for every j. The exact-idempotent row identity p_v=sum_j a_j p_j and sum_j a_j=1 imply p_v=q+sum_j a_j^-(q-p_j), hence ||p_v-q||_1<=sum_j a_j^-D=nu_v*(2+4*delta).
